content:
This mod introduces brand-new tools and weapons entirely independent of the vanilla system for Tetra!
The weapons include original creations and crossovers from other games, such as:
 
Phainon and Jingliu's weapons from Honkai: Star Rail,
Amiya and Flametail's weapons from Arknights,
The Chainsword from Warhammer,
The Mortal Blade from Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice!
For tools, the mod adds:
 
A versatile multi-tool combining functions of a pickaxe, axe, shovel, claw, hammer, and knife.
The Traveler’s Staff enabling teleportation!
This expansion enhances Tetra’s customization system with unique mechanics and cross-game flair, aligning with the mod’s goal to diversify weapon types and material integrations.

这个模组为tetra新增了独立于原版的全新工具与武器！
武器分为模组原创武器与一些来自于其他游戏的武器，例如崩坏星穹铁道中白厄、镜流的武器，明日方舟中阿米娅、焰尾的武器，战锤的链锯剑，只狼影逝二度中的不死斩拜泪！
工具方面，模组新增了可以同时作为镐、斧、锹、爪、锤、刀的强力功能型工具，与可以进行传送的旅行者之杖！
